what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Jamaica in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7541 Jamaican asylum seekers, and the United States hosted 68.7% of them.
After the United States, the largest hosts are Canada, Trinidad and Tobago and the United Kingdom.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Jamaica, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 173 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 9460, at the end of 2024, and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
